statement: ∀ n : ℕ, (x ^ n) ((y ^ n) v) = ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ∏ t ∈ Finset.range n, (((lam - (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ))) • v
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ x, Module.End.mul_apply, (h_T001 n).2, map_smul, ih]
      simp only [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Finset.prod_range_succ, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
